title: Xbox Live Outage That Shaped Cloud

scenes.text: The 2005 Xbox Live outage that impacted 1.5 million gamers
The server crash lasted roughly two hours before services restored

scenes.query: Microsoft backend rewrite after Xbox Live outage
scenes.text: Microsoft rewrote its backend architecture, leading to today’s cloud gaming platform

description: When Xbox Live went down in 2005, it forced Microsoft to overhaul its infrastructure, paving the way for today’s streaming games. See how a failure became a breakthrough.
